`_codelists.yml` defines the codelists used in a study. It is an optional file
in the study directory. Load it with `mighty_codelists()`, either directly or
as the `@codelists` property of `mighty_study()`. Columns refer to a codelist
by its `id` in their `codelist` field. The file structure is defined by a
[JSON-schema](https://json-schema.org) accessible with:

```r
system.file("schema", "codelists.json", package = "mighty.metadata")
```

# Operation groups

Each codelist has an `id` and at least one of four operation groups. The groups
fall into two kinds: a sponsor-defined codelist, or changes to a codelist from
an external source of controlled terminology (e.g. CDISC CT).

| Group | Kind | Entries | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | Sponsor-defined | `code`, optional `decode` | Defines all values of a codelist that does not exist externally |
| `subset` | External | `code` | Keeps only these values from the external codelist |
| `restore` | External | `code` | Includes SDTM controlled terminology values in the ADaM codelist even when they are not used in the SDTM define.xml |
| `extend` | External | `code`, optional `decode` | Adds sponsor-defined values to an extensible external codelist |

A codelist with `values` must also have `label`, `description` and `datatype`.
For the other groups these fields are optional, as they come from the external
codelist.

`values` cannot be combined with `subset` or `restore` on the same codelist.
Codelist `id`s must be unique, and `code` must be unique across all groups
within a codelist (compared as text, so `1` and `"1"` are duplicates).
Each group must have at least one entry, and within a group either all or none
of the entries have a `decode`, which is written to `TranslatedText` in
define.xml. Entries in `subset` and `restore` have only a `code`.

# Example

```yaml
# A sponsor-defined codelist
- id: REGION
  label: Codelist for region
  description: Region codelist
  datatype: text
  values:
    - code: EUROPE
      decode: Europe
    - code: NORTH AMERICA
      decode: North America

# Keep two values of an external codelist and restore one more
- id: AGEU
  subset:
    - code: YEARS
    - code: MONTHS
  restore:
    - code: DAYS

# Add a sponsor-defined value to an extensible external codelist
- id: LOC
  extend:
    - code: MY CUSTOM LOCATION
      decode: My Custom Location
```

A column refers to a codelist by its `id`:

```yaml
columns:
  - id: REGION
    label: Region
    codelist: REGION
```

Codelists do not have to be referenced by a column, e.g. when they are added
before the columns that use them. Use `check_codelist_references()` to check
that every codelist in a study is referenced by at least one column (including
columns within parameters). It does not check the opposite direction: a column
referring to a codelist that is not defined in `_codelists.yml` is not
reported.

`code` can be a string or a number. Since yaml infers types, unquoted values
that look like numbers (e.g. `code: 1`) are read as numbers.

# Schema reference

The full schema definition, generated from `codelists.json`:

```{r echo=FALSE}
S7schema::document_schema(
  x = system.file("schema", "codelists.json", package = "mighty.metadata"),
  header_start_level = 2
)
```
